zsphnx10.name: Sphinx
zsphnx10.description: A mysterious guardian offering a risky trial: a blessing or curse lasting 1-7 days. Costs 1,280 movement points. One trial per hero per day.

{Sphinx}

The guardian has already judged you today. Return tomorrow.
zsphnx10.onEmptyMessage:
{Sphinx}
